analysis:
Documentation-only change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md. Visible changed hunks: a new sentence at head lines ~1210-1212 (shutdown waits up to 15s per model unload, then leaves stuck native retirement to process exit, ProviderLoop.unloadAllModelsForShutdown) and a rewritten status-output bullet at head ~1290-1305 (a restart-needed notice for enabled_models drift, with enabled_models_at_start and enabled_models_at_last_switch daemon state fields). I examined both supplied units, which cover the head text from line 386 to 1236. The remaining reviewed text is unchanged context, including logout, the sandbox installer and the addon hold.

No code, config, protocol or default changes. The prose describes existing behavior and does not weaken any control. The logout section (A-008) states that only HTTP 204 confirms remote revocation and that local-only logout is flagged as unconfirmed. The sandbox setup docs (TB-013/T-061) state that the CLI relies on TLS only and that the installer verifies the release. The addon hold docs (TB-012) describe the lifecycle mailbox. None of these is altered in a way that invalidates the threat model.

The bounded 15s unload wait leaving a stuck native retirement to process exit is a documented availability and lifecycle detail. It does not expose key or prompt material beyond what T-028 and T-014 already cover. The statement that the status output shows enabled_models drift is informational. The patch excerpt was truncated, so the full status bullet tail was not visible. Claims in the docs about the code (for example, the unloadAllModelsForShutdown timeout) cannot be verified because no source was supplied. This is a documentation-accuracy question, not a security finding.
